programme.title: The Addams Family

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: After Pugsley befriends Gorgo, a circus gorilla, Gorgo decides to follow Pugsley and Gomez home, where is accepted as one of the family. But Gorgo gives Morticia's tea guests, the Ladies League members, quite a shock.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester applies for a job as an insurance salesman with the same company which is threatening to cancel the Addamses' policy (because Fester keeps blowing things up). Fester convinces the company interviewer that he is qualified for the job.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez (John Astin) loses his memory after hitting his head; he fails to recognize Morticia (Carolyn Jones) and says the house looks like a condemned museum. The Addamses take turns hitting Gomez on the head trying to help him regain his memory.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's cousin, Melancholia, wants to marry Clarence P. Harvey after most of her marital prospects have joined the Foreign Legion. Clarence recoils when Melancholia puts on a campaign to win him, backed by Morticia, Gomez and Clarence's boss.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's electrical output fails abruptly. Should they call a doctor or an electrician to bring Fester back? Morticia prescribes a bowl of porcupine mold, and both she and Gomez agree that long exposure to moon rays would be beneficial.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch's tiny fire-eating mother visits and demands that Lurch's employers wait on her boy hand-and-foot after Lurch leads her to believe that it's his house. Lurch revels in the unexpected attention he gets from Morticia and Gomez.
programme.sub-title: Mother Lurch Visits The Addams Family

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez decides to bolster Cousin Itt's failing ego by making him the star of a production aimed as a birthday surprise for Wednesday. He hires the great director, Eric von Bissell, who gives Itt elocution lessons, causing a Hollywood star complex.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley and Wednesday start a row at a party when their gift of a tarantula upsets Harold, the birthday boy. Harold's parents insist that the Addams children lack breeding and, therefore, are no longer allowed to play with their son.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia, in order to be part of the National Beautification Program, decides to become a home decorator and offers her services to the neighbors. Next door neighbor, and insurance agent, Joe Digby hires Morticia in hopes of selling them insurance.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's concern that Lurch is overworked leads Gomez to the operating table to assemble a custom-built secondary butler. Lurch lets the robot do all the work and then begins to feel that he isn't needed anymore.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley copies one of his dad's old love letters and sends it to his teacher. Miss Dunbar comes to visit the Addams home and confesses to Gomez that no man has ever fallen so in love with her, leading Morticia to pretend to be the jealous wife.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez decide to keep Wednesday and Pugsley home from school after Morticia sees the fairy tales they have to read. When the truant officer comes to investigate, he is shocked at what he finds.
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Goes To School

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Taken in by a psychologist's pronouncement that the only happily married couples are those who fight members of the Addams household devise schemes to start a battle between Gomez (John Astin) and Morticia (Carolyn Jones).

programme.title: The Addams Family

programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Meets A Beatnik

programme.desc: Because she thinks Fester (Jackie Coogan) and Grandmama (Blossom Rock) are spoiling the children, Morticia (Carolyn Jones) hires a governess. Insulted, Fester paints a white line down the center of the Addams house, dividing it in half.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Official visitors from an unfriendly nation receive the shock of their lives when they decide to exploit the Addams Family as an average uncultured family. The visitors are shaken up by Morticia's carnivorous plants among other things.
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Meets The V.I.P.'s

programme.desc: Grandmama (Blossom Rock) is hauled off to jail for setting up a fortune-telling booth in the Addamses' living room. Gomez (John Astin) volunteers to act as attorney, and the court session becomes a shambles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: In need of artistic fulfillment, Morticia takes up sculpting. An art critic views her first endeavor--a three-eyed Gomez statue--and clubs it with his cane. Gomez, who won't have Morticia's heart broken gets a seedy art dealer to buy it.

programme.desc: An organ grinder's fugitive monkey leads Fester to believe that he has turned Pugsley into a monkey. Morticia and Gomez treat the monkey as though he were their son, welcoming him to the dinner table and giving him Pugsley's chores.

programme.desc: When Ophelia laments that she has been jilted, Morticia suggests a career as an alternative to marriage. She tries chemistry first (with explosive results) then turns to operatic singing. Cousin Itt is summoned to coach her to stardom.

programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez visit Mayor Henson to complain that their property tax is ridiculously low. After the Mayor proves his incompetence by offering a refund, Gomez is persuaded to become a candidate for the office.

programme.title: Floyd Mayeather vs Jose Luis Castillo 2
programme.desc: On December 7th, 2002 Floyd Mayweather faced Jose Luis Castillo for a second time at Mandalay Bay Resort & Casino in Las Vegas for WBC World lightweight titles resulting in a unamimous decision win for Mayweather.

programme.title: Floyd Mayweather Jr vs Justin Juuko
programme.desc: On May 22nd, 1999 Floyd Mayweather fought Justin Juuko at the Mandalay Bay Resort & Casino in Las Vegas for the WBC World Super featherweight title with the bout ending in round nine resulting in a victory for Mayweather

programme.title: Floyd Mayweather vs Arturo Gatti
programme.desc: On June 25th, 2005 Floyd Mayweather fought Arturo Gatti at the Boardwalk Hall in Atlantic City for the WBC World Super Lightweight title with Gatti down in round 1 the fight ended in a victory for Mayweather.

programme.title: Floyd Mayweather vs Carlos Alberto Ramon Rios
programme.desc: On February 17th, 1999, Floyd Mayweather fought Carlos Rios for the WBC Super Featherweight Title in Grand Rapids, Michigan. Rios was a tough opponent for Mayweather, but Mayweather prevailed and showed out in front of his hometown, winning by UD.

programme.title: Floyd Mayweather vs DeMarcus Corley
programme.desc: On May 22nd, 2004 Floyd Mayweather fought DeMarcus Corley at the Boardwalk Hall in Atlantic City for the WBC World Light Welterweight Title eliminator with Corely going down in round 8 and round 10 resulting in a win for Mayweather.

programme.title: Floyd Mayweather vs Diego Corrales
programme.desc: On January 20th, 2001 Floyd Mayweather faced Diego Corrales in a battle for the WBC World super feather weight titles at the MGM Grand in Las Vegas ending in a technical knockout victory for Mayweather.

programme.title: Floyd Mayweather vs Hector Arroyo
programme.desc: On January 9th, 1998, Floyd Mayweather fought Hector Arroyo in a featherweight bout in Biloxi, Mississippi. A young Mayweather hungry for a title shot came out quick against Arroyo, stopping him in the fifth round of the fight.

programme.title: Floyd Mayweather vs Larry O'Shields
programme.desc: On June 14th, 1997, Floyd Mayweather fought Larry O'Shields in a lightweight bout at the Alamodome in San Antonio, Texas. A young Mayweather showed his impressive speed and agility, earning a unanimous decision victory.

programme.title: Floyd Mayweather vs Manny Pacquiao
programme.desc: On May 2nd, 2015, Floyd Mayweather fought Manny Pacquiao in what was labeled as the "Fight of the Century." Floyd Mayweather emerged victorious via a unanimous decision, showcasing his exceptional defensive skills against Pacquiao's aggressive style.

programme.title: Floyd Mayweather vs Phillip N'dou
programme.desc: On November 1st, 2003 Floyd Mayweather and Phillip N'dou fought eachother for the WBC world lightweight title at the Van Andel Arena in Grand Rapids with Mayweather ending the bout early for a technical knockout victory

programme.title: Floyd Mayweather vs Zab Judah
programme.desc: On April 8th, 2006, Floyd Mayweather fought Zab Judah for the IBF and IBO Welterweight Titles at Thomas & Mack Center in Las Vegas. In a fight with a dramatic melee in round 10, Mayweather cruised in the later rounds to win by unanimous decision.

programme.title: Freddie Roach vs Joe Ruelaz
programme.desc: On August 9th, 1984, Freddie Roach fought Joe Ruelaz in a super featherweight bout in Las Vegas. The more experienced Roach made easy work of Ruelaz, stopping him in the fourth round.

programme.title: Freddie Roach vs Mario Chavez
programme.desc: On May 28th, 1981 Freddie Roach faced Mario Chavez at the Hacienda Hotel in Las Vegas resulting in a unanimous decision win for Roach.

programme.title: Genaro Hernandez vs Azumah Nelson
programme.desc: On March 22nd, 1997, Genaro Hernandez fought Azumah Nelson for the World Super Featherweight Championship at the Memorial Coliseum in Corpus Christi. Hernandez looked like the more confident fighter, earning a close split decision victory.

programme.title: George Foreman vs Adilson Rodrigues
programme.desc: On June 16th, 1990 George Foreman fought Adilson Rodrigues at Caesars Palace in Las Vegas resulting in a victory for Foreman in round two by technical knockout.

programme.title: George Foreman vs Alex Stewart
programme.desc: On April 11th, 1992 George Foreman faced Alex Stewart at the Thomas & Mack Center in Las Vegas ending in a majority decision victory for Foreman.

programme.title: George Foreman vs Gerry Cooney
programme.desc: On January 15th, 1990 George Foreman and Gerry Cooney fought at the Reno-Sparks Convention Center in Reno, Las Vegas ending in a majority decision victory for Foreman.

programme.title: George Kambosos vs Devin Haney 1
programme.desc: On June 5th, 2022 George Kambosos and Devin Haney fought for the first time at Marvel Stadium in Melboure for the IBF, WBA, WBC & WBO World lightweight titles resulting in a victory for Devin Haney.

programme.title: Giovani Santillan vs Angel Ruiz
programme.desc: On October 15th, 2021 Giovani Santillan and Angel Ruiz fought eachother in a 10 round bout at the Pechanga Arena in San Diego resulting in a victory for Santillan.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: As the owners of Karras Games gather for a murder mystery weekend, the immersive experience takes a puzzling twist when a killer strikes for real. The police's detective skills are put to the test as they are forced to solve this case on their own.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: The annual Midsomer Scarecrow Festival takes a grisly turn as bodies begin appearing on poles displayed alongside their straw creations; the investigation reveals rivalries that run deep and shows people will do just about anything to win.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: The Midsomer Mummers, an amateur operatic society, rehearses for its charity concert when the body of an unknown man is found in the theatre; the investigation quickly becomes a race to discover who is desperate to take centre stage.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Each year, the village of Angel's Rise hosts the Psychic Fayre. Founded by the Saint-Stephens family in memory of their late daughter, the event attracts mediums, psychics and followers of the occult. When a body is found surrounded by ritual symbols on the eve of the festival, Barnaby must step into the spiritual world to find the killer.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: The residents of Milton Cross, a feudal estate with a church, farms, houses and acres of land, depend on lord of the manor Edward Milton for their livelihoods. But when Sonia Woodley is stabbed in the churchyard two years after the death of her abusive husband Gerald, Barnaby and Jones investigate, trying to work out who killed her. It soon becomes clear someone took a pair of tailor scissors to do the deed, but who amongst the villagers could have done so, is unclear, and the investigation is complicated, when the pair learn the local Anglican priest, the parish vicar, had received a letter from Sonia. When he himself is killed, the pair believe something in the letter may be key to solving the mystery.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Barnaby is not convinced about Mayor David Hicks' plans to revive an annual trip to Brighton, suspecting his proposal to buy coastal land there, is rather a fraudulent scheme. Naturally, he joins the trip, but during their time in Brighton, a hated property developer (Tim McInnerny) is beheaded on a ghost house ride, prompting Barnaby to team up with his cousin to determine whether the developer's renters, the mayor, a gloomy reverend (Mark Gatiss), or the lady of a large estate are responsible, and soon discovers a hotbed of jealously, debt, lies and more, conceal a far darker secret.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Ford Florey is a town with a Wild West Society and many grudges. During a Wild West show at the local faire, the witch on the 'Dunk the Witch' stall is well and truly dunked but laughter soon turns to horror when she doesn't get up and the water in the tank starts to turn red. Barnaby and Jones need to be quick on the draw to track down the murderer, and soon begin to wonder whether a dispute over land was the motive, or something far more sinister, especially when more people are killed, with methods linked to the Wild West.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: On a dark night in the village of March Magna, Barnaby's wife Joyce swerves her car and narrowly misses a shadowy figure in the road - or so she thinks, when later that night a body is discovered in the old cemetery. The victim was a member of the council who was strange and weird, but someone seemed to have quite a grudge on him, and so Barnaby and Jones delve into his background, and the village, attempting to determine who might have wanted him dead, finding ghosts, grudges, and more beneath the village's surface.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Piano student Zoe Stock has won a place at the Devington Manor Winter School led by internationally renowned musician, Sir Michael Fielding (James Fox). Yet when she is there, things become mysterious when from the river bank in the grounds of the manor she sees a woman jump from the bridge and disappear underwater. When Barnaby and Jones start investigating the possible drowning, they discover unsavoury connections to the past that could prove lethal 20 years later, especially when someone attempts to kill. It isn't long, before murder does occur, and the detectives attempt to fathom what occurred in the drowning, and the present day murders.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: When Midsomer Morchard's very own boxer, John Kinsella, wins a world title in New York, the success seems to be a joyous time for all, until murder rears its ugly head. When a local solicitor is found dead by his assistant and Kinsella's manager, Barnaby attempts to determine what is going on, and soon discover issues with inheritance, affairs, anger, and gambling to make matters difficult. Meanwhile Kinsella's trainer Teddy Molloy (Phil Daniels) has his own hidden agenda. When a re-enactment of a Victorian boxing match gets heated, and Kinsella's manager is found dead in his home's gym, the pair attempt to determine who is responsible, although Barnaby's judgement seems to be clouded on this one.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: A planning dispute turns to murder, after a leading light in the Midsomer Conservation Society suspects her neighbours are involved in a money-making development scam. Political wrangling, burglaries and sexual liaisons abound in picturesque Great Pelfe - but when a member of the possible scam is themselves murdered, Barnaby wonders what is truly going on behind the scenes of an important by-election.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Barnaby reluctantly accompanies Joyce on a spa weekend to Swavely Manor. But as he attempts to de-stress, a woman is found dead in the flotation chamber. He abandons his treatment to investigate, but his personal worries are never far away as he contemplates his future, while trying to determine if an argument between the spa's owners and their neighbours is the motive, or something else.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: As the Barnabys prepare for Cully's wedding, Lord Fitzroy and Beth Porteous are married in the pretty village of Bledlow. At the lavish reception at Bledlow Hall that follows, however, tragedy strikes - maid of honour Marina Fellowes is found murdered in one of the rooms by some of the guests. With their honeymoon cancelled, the Fitzroys must contend with a police presence in their home, as Barnaby and Jones try to learn more about the family history. It soon becomes clear there are secrets, deception, and an illegtimate son involved in the mystery, which is further complicated when the estate manager is killed by an arrow.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: It's a good day for the Hicks family, as the name of Tommy Hicks - who was executed during World War I for "cowardice and desertion" - is added to the list on Midsomer Parva's war memorial. Tommy's son Lionel and grandson Dave, mayor of Causton and whom Barnaby does not like (owing to dodgy building work by the mayor's company), are thrilled, but the snooty Hammonds are decidedly less pleased. Henry, the patriarch of the Hammond family, is particularly riled by his insalubrious neighbours, and has nurtured a long-running feud with the Hickses. But the evening after a battle re-enactment in the village, Henry is murdered - and Barnaby must delve into the history of the two families to find the killer, discovering a web of fraud, lies, and hidden truths.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Barnaby and Jones are in Dunstan to investigate the deaths of a reclusive couple. As they try to establish whether Ron and Libby Wilson were murdered or died of natural causes, their attention is drawn to a dispute raging between a local builder and road protesters nearby. When another death occurs, the detectives learn that there are plenty of dark secrets and fierce hostilities in this apparently idyllic village. Will Jack Purdy's quick temper lead to violence? How far would the protesters go to prevent the bypass being built? And do current events somehow relate to the death of Michael Wilson many years earlier?

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: When the body of Londoner Charlie Finleyson is discovered in woodland near Midsomer Sonning, Barnaby and Jones find themselves investigating employees at local Midsomer Life magazine. It turns out the dead man was married to the ex-wife of Guy Sandys, the wealthy owner of the publication. As the detectives become aware of a feud between Guy and the proprietor of the Morecroft Hotel, tensions are also heating up between the locals and visiting Londoners. Soon Barnaby and Jones find themselves to trying to piece together the truth about the murder, and learn that someone might be trying to conceal something in their past.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: When a pub landlady is crushed to death during a magic show in Midsomer Oaks, Barnaby and Nelson uncover conflict between the village church and ancient pagan traditions. Is famous magician Gideon Latimer to blame or is he the target?

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Barnaby and Jones are forced to take part in a team building exercise and Tom has plenty of problems dealing with the young, new, acting Chief Superintendent, John Cotton (Nick Fletcher). Following an explosion in a truck that had been stored in a truck depot, a body is soon discovered in a nearby lake, which turns out to be Alec Grainger, who had been seen arguing with James Parkes (Joseph Millson), the son of Colonel Matt Parkes (Tim Pigott-Smith). James appears to be involved in shady business deals and is blamed by his grandmother Caroline Halsey (Judy Parfitt) - and others - for the suicide of a woman he got pregnant two years before. Barnaby and Jones find themselves delving into a mixture of fraud, smuggling, and lies, trying to piece together the truth.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: When two couples vanish into thin air in the village of Monks Barton, Barnaby and Jones hear rumours of haunted woods and witchcraft. Barnaby remains sceptical of this, even when an unidentified body is found in a shallow grave and the missing start turning up dead. He soon has to determine if ghosts, criminals, or something else, is behind the abductions and murders.

programme.title: Hunting Land Man
programme.desc: In this episode, we dive into how we are using our knowledge and experience to not only get some amazing hunting property, but to have other people pay for it. Sound too good to be true? We also take you on some great hunts we’ve had on our journey flipping land and think back on some memories from the past and what the future is going to look like. We hope you can learn a thing or two in this episode and encourage you to reach out with any questions you may have about this process.

programme.title: Hunting Land Man
programme.desc: In this episode, Slade takes you on a ride through one of the coolest cities in the south, the historic Natchez, Mississippi. This is an area in which Slade sells a lot of hunting land and being only 40 minutes from where he grew up, Slade is very familiar with all there is to do in the area not only from a recreational standpoint but also for entertainment. Slade takes you through the showing process on a beautiful piece of property and bring it full circle at the closing. You’ll also watch a deer hunt with Slade in Natchez that was featured on Realtree Monster Bucks DVD. This is a jampacked episode with so much to learn and also enjoy. We know you’ll love it.

programme.title: Operation Healing Heroes

programme.title: Operation Healing Heroes

programme.desc: Follow TTHA President/CEO Christina Pittman and her husband Matt this week as they tag along side Dr. James Kroll for his annual deer day! programme.title: Storytellers
programme.desc: We are blessed for the opportunity to follow along the guys from Trinity Oaks for Bucks for the Brave. The men and women that served in our armed services and as first responders, had jobs that required the, to be willing to sacrifice their own lives every day, in order to protect or save someone else's. Not many of us can say that, nor understand what that truly means. The things they've had to see, and the sacrifices they've made in their daily lives, can have a profound impact on them. Trinity Oaks' Bucks for the Brave platform allows the loved ones and communities that support these heroes to share their stories and unite us all in honoring and recognizing their service to our great nation. We are proud to continue to be a part of this incredible program, getting these heroes in the outdoors for the hunt of a lifetime.

programme.title: Storytellers
programme.desc: John Sewell has played a huge part in the development of feeding Fortified Cottonseed 365 days a year. programme.title: Storytellers
programme.desc: We love our college chapters. Hudson has been a long time member of TTHA as well as serving with the Texas A&M Chapter. We have a great time at G2 in pursuit of Axis deer.

programme.title: Storytellers

programme.title: Storytellers

programme.title: Storytellers

programme.title: Storytellers
programme.desc: This is the story of how FE Hill ranch got it's start. From its inception, FE Hill has created opportunities for people to experience the outdoors and create memories. For us, it has created a tradition of Fathers and Sons hunting together.

programme.desc: When the captain calls and says the weather in Alaska is great, you don't waste the opportunity. So Capt. Blair and the whole crew head out for a day of fishing. With one camera on the boat, things got a little chaotic with all the catching going on.

programme.title: Blair Wiggins Outdoors
programme.desc: Down in Sebastion, the monster snook wait. These fish are so elusive, men have gotten divorced chasing these things. These can be once in a lifetime fish, and even then it's not a guarantee.

programme.desc: Kyle and Jeff dive into the wild waters off Hawaii’s coast, coming face-to-face with sharks and graceful manta rays. The adrenaline peaks when Kyle takes a heart-pounding leap off a towering 40-foot cliff, making this adventure as daring as it is unforgettable.

programme.title: The Green Way Outdoors
programme.desc: Kyle and Jeff explore the breathtaking Waipio Valley, the Hawaiian "Valley of the Kings," in search of prawns and bullfrogs. Their adventure continues up a massive volcano, hunting invasive rams, before ending with a feast of native fish paired with island fruits and spices.

programme.title: The Green Way Outdoors

programme.desc: The ice is finally broken in Nebraska!! Brent Purvis, pastor of Cascade Hills Church in Columbus, GA goes after his first ever velvet buck. The crew also dove hunts in the morning and cooks up some Timber to Table Dove poppers.

programme.title: Realtree Roadtrips
programme.desc: The crew needed a weather change to get the bucks on their feet before shooting light ended in Nebraska. They got their wish. Highs in the 100's changed to highs in the 60's and sustained 30 MPH winds! Check out Pitts' 5th day hunt for the target buck he's been after all week!

programme.title: Realtree Road Trips
programme.desc: On his third trip of the season to Kansas, Tyler Jordan finally connects on a big flyer buck with his Hoyt RX-10 in hand. Everything comes together in a heart-pounding moment that bow hunters dream about.

programme.title: Realtree Roadtrips
programme.desc: Chipper Jones heads down to Harris County, Georgia to hunt with the rest of the Road Trips crew. On day 2 of his hunt, he moves into a ground blind on Realtree Farms. The move proved to be the right one as a buck nicknamed “Triple Threat” stayed consistent on his summer pattern and offered Chipper a 25 yard shot!

programme.title: Realtree Roadtrips
programme.desc: After a slow opening day with hot, humid temperatures, the focus shifts back to "Big Heavy" on day 2 of bow season. Chipper Jones joins Tyler in camp at Realtree Farms on September 10th to try his luck on a Georgia giant as well. A quick tweak to Tyler's tree stand location proves to be the right move. At 6:30, Tyler spots "Big Heavy' moving into the same orchard that he hunted on opening day! An epic bow hunt ends in celebration for the road trips crew!

programme.title: Realtree Roadtrips
programme.desc: Bryan Brown and Michael Pitts have an epic week of bowhunting in Georgia during the rut! Did EHD cause a foot injury on the giant 10 point that Pitts was hunting?

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: Over a decade after the game changing Longbeard XR was introduced by Winchester, the wait is finally over for their next ground breaking turkey load. After years of perfecting the recipe behind the scenes, Winchester finally unveiled the new Longbeard TSS at a turkey camp in northern Michigan. First watch the jaw dropping Longbeard TSS pattern board testing, then see it go to work on some spring gobblers.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: Nestled in the hills of Ohio just west of the Appalachians is a very special deer camp ripe with memories from deer season’s past. With the development of the 350 Legend straight-walled cartridge by Winchester in 2019, a world of opportunities now existed in states like Ohio and Michigan. In this episode, with the 350 Legend in hand, three mature whitetails meet their maker, from the same blind, over the course of three seasons.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: It’s been 60 years since AA Tracker was introduced to the shooting sports world. Since that day, an immeasurable number of AA hulls have hit the ground and countless shooters have stood center stage raising a trophy where millions of dollars have been won. Professional and recreational shooters alike have trusted AA for six decades. In this episode, load up for stories of high school, collegiate competitors and the world’s best as they bust clays with the legendary shot shell.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: For the first time in history, the World English Sporting Clays Championship was held in the United States at the incredible M&M Hunting Preserve owned by the Matarese family in New Jersey. Watch as Winchester’s best shooters vie for Gold as they compete against over 2,500 shooters and 17 countries. We’ll also join the Kids and Clays foundation in Florida as they host an event that will most certainly touch your soul.

programme.title: Hard Truths of Conservation
programme.desc: How important is the wild harvest to communities in North America? Dan Cabela travels from Kansas to Newfoundland in search of the answer, meeting rural communities that rely on the yearly cycle of wild game harvest.

programme.title: Hard Truths of Conservation
programme.desc: Often misunderstood, brown bears are one of North America's most formidable predators. Taking part in a scientific collaring program to better understand predator-prey interactions, Dan Cabela travels to Kodiak Island to meet the research team.

programme.title: Wildbound by Forloh
programme.desc: In this episode Andy and his friend Scotty take on Kodiak Island, Alaska for an adventure of Salmon fishing and hunting black tail deer. Whilst traversing steep mountains in the company of Kodiak brown bears and taking on cold Alaskan waters, Andy presents useful information for fellow outdoor enthusiasts all whilst building friendships with the great people of Kodiak Big Timber Lodge.

programme.title: Wildbound by Forloh
programme.desc: In this episode Andy goes back to his home farm in Alabama for deer and quail hunting. Not only does he make incredible dishes with his former ‘masterchef’ contestant Alex which he serves to local children in need but he explains how hunting is never about “just the hunt” but about the camaraderie, friendship and memories made through the pursuit of the harvest.

programme.title: Local Knowledge
programme.desc: Water quality is everything—and the Star brite - SeaSafe team is back at it for the second year in a row! Led by Cory Redwine, Conservation Director of Project SeaSafe, this is the 4th Annual Clean Water Collective and it’s bigger than ever. This time, we’re in Grant, Florida, where 4 million clams are being released into the Indian River Lagoon, paired with the planting of thousands of mangroves, oyster work by CCA and trash clean ups to help restore one of Florida’s most critical ecosystems. But it’s not just about hard work—it’s about connection. With local captains, fishing legends, and the Local Knowledge crew on hand, we hit the water to show why this place is worth fighting for. From clam drops by drone, to in-water mangrove planting, to monster snook catches, this is hands-on conservation at its best. This two-part series kicks off with action, heart, and the kind of hope only a healthy waterway can bring. Don’t miss Part 1—where conservation meets community and everyone gets their hands wet.

programme.desc: The jungle in the north of Vietnam is nearly impenetrable and there are parts where no human has ever set foot on before. The rainforest oft he Pu Mat Nationalpark is a retreat for threatened animals like the Asian black bear, pangonlins or rare species of monkeys. Tuan, a biologist and specialist for bears, explores the untouched regions of the nationalpark to find the black bear. The animals which are hunted the most are Pangolins. It is believed that their scale has healing power and their meat is considered a delicacy. A small vietnamese animal protection organisation fights for the suvival of this species.

programme.title: Asia
programme.sub-title: Secret Lives, Hidden Places - Great Gobi National Park: Mongolia - Following the Wild Camels
programme.desc: The Great Gobi Nationalpark in the southwest of Mongolia is home oft he most fascinationg mammals alive: the wild camels. The arcaic desert, impenetrable and misterious, ist he home of approximately 800 wild camels which are nearly extinct. The Gobi is one of the most sparsely populated areas around the world. We experience humans which live in the rough and misanthropic desert: Jangaa who breeds camels and specialises in camel polo Surendjav who owns a salt mine Erdene who built an oasis in the middle of the dessert.

programme.title: Stories of the Hidden Worlds
programme.desc: Dharavi is a locality in Mumbai, India, considered to be one of the world's largest slums. Dharavi has an area of just over 2.1 square kilometers and a population of about 700,000. Dharavi is one of the most densely populated areas in the world. The Dharavi slum was founded in 1884 during the British colonial era and grew in part because of an expulsion of factories and residents from the peninsular city center by the colonial government, and from the migration of poor rural Indians into urban Mumbai. For this reason, Dharavi is currently a highly multi-religious, multi-ethnic, and diverse settlement. Dharavi has an active informal economy in which numerous household enterprises employ many of the slum residents leather, textiles, and pottery products are among the goods made inside Dharavi.

programme.desc: Actress Im Se Ra (Jang Da A) is on top of the world after becoming the youngest winner of a best actress award. Unfortunately, that same night, she's hit by a truck - and transported 25 years into the future, where she wakes up in the body of middle-aged woman Bong Cheong Ja (Uhm Jung Hwa). Cheong Ja decides to return to acting, hoping to restore her former glory and figure out what happened to her. She's assisted by Dokgo Cheol (Song Seung Heon), a former violent crimes detective who got demoted to traffic duty... and who shares a mysterious past connection with Se Ra. To both Cheong Ja and Cheol's surprise, they begin to fall for each other, sending their lives onto an entirely new trajectory.

programme.title: LEGO Marvel Super Heroes: Avengers Reassembled
programme.desc: Finally, the Avengers confront Ultron and his Ultron Minions as they attack Avengers' Tower. Ultron's ultimate plan: use all the data/stuff they've stolen to free the newly rebuilt IRON LEGION, destroy the Avengers, and control the world. Tony dons the hastily repaired Hulk Buster Armor and it's on! It's a huge battle as the Avengers try to save their beloved HQ and defeat Ultron. Will they succeed? And, more importantly, can their party be saved after Ultron tries to take down their Tower?The Avengers must now fight one of their own, and they're not sure what to do! Cap and Thor lead the charge, but can't fend off Iron Man and Ultron's Minions. Meanwhile, Black Widow, Hawkeye and Hulk track down a signal that seems to be controlling Iron Man from a castle in the “Little Sokovia” section of New York. There they fight HYDRA and BARON VON STRUCKER and learn that YELLOWJACKET is the “bug” that infected Iron Man's suit for Ultron. To help break Iron Man free from Ultron's control, the Avengers call in their own bug...ANT MAN! The Avengers prepare for a party with a surprise guest when Ultron crashes the preparations by using mind control on Iron Man. While trying to rescue their leader, the rest of the team discovers that Baron Stucker, HYDRA, and Yellowjacket are in on Ultron's plans. While preparing for a party at Avengers' Tower, THE AVENGERS (IRON MAN, CAPTAIN AMERICA, BLACK WIDOW, HAWKEYE, THOR, HULK and VISION) notice Iron Man acting strangely. When Iron Man volunteers to go out and get more ice, they find it odd: when has Tony every volunteered to get anything? Suddenly, ULTRON appears on a screen: he's taken control of Iron Man! To make matters worse, Ultron takes over all the versions of Iron Man's armor and they fly off!

programme.title: The Power Of Merlok
programme.desc: When Jestro attacks a village on the far side of the Kingdom, the NEXO-Knights wonder how they'll get there. Then Macy remembers her dad has a royal RV…maybe they can “mod” that for their own, “knightly” use? Now the NEXO-Knights get rolling…in THE FORTREX, their own ROLLING CASTLE! This great new HQ, which houses Merlok 2.0 as an operating system, will be how the knights move around Knighton and protect it from Jestro and his monsters. Speaking of the evil jester, in this episode Jestro uses some newly-made monsters to attack a town far from the capitol where he thinks he's safe from the Knights' reach. We see two parallel stories here: the Knights training, learning more about digital magic and getting organized as a team and at the same time we see Jestro making monsters, trying to learn how his powers work and talking to the Book. In the end, the Knights roll up in their castle and defeat Jestro and his marauding monsters. Lance thinks he should be the leader because he's a snot. “Of course I'm the leader…I'm a Richmond.”

We scouted it that evening, found birds, and on a rainy morning the next day, everything finally came together. Sometimes all it takes is one more push.

programme.title: Vámonos para la feria
programme.desc: Un hombre decide que es hora de que sus dos hijos se casen. Para eso, acude a su compadre, que tiene dos bellas hijas.

programme.title: Noche de muerte
programme.desc: Un delincuente se disfraza como un famoso luchador y asalta varios lugares matando a los guardias de seguridad.

programme.title: Dos valientes
programme.desc: Martín, un pistolero, es asesinado, pero antes de morir pide que le oculten su identidad a su hijo. Este corre peligro cuando asiste a su funeral.

programme.title: Santo: Infraterrestre
programme.desc: Las fuerzas del bien se enfrentan a las malévolas intenciones de los Infraterrestres, seres de otro planeta que intentarán apoderarse de la Tierra.

programme.title: El corrido de María Pistolas
programme.desc: Un hombre finge estar del lado de los ricos para enterarse de sus planes, y así los revolucionarios venzan en un ataque.

programme.title: Con la Muerte en Ancas
programme.desc: Dos pistoleros, con personalidades distintas, uno, un hombre justo, y el otro, un asesino psicópata, buscan la venganza.

programme.title: Cuna de valientes
programme.desc: En colegio militar, cuatro jóvenes se hacen amigos y juntos comparten mucho, pero solamente dos de ellos se gradúan.

programme.title: Con el Odio en la Piel
programme.desc: Un sheriff y sus malévolos secuaces humillan y asesinan a los mexicanos que viven en un pueblo fronterizo de Texas.

programme.title: Milagro en el Barrio
programme.desc: Un niño ciego y el hijo de una rica familia se hacen amigos aún en contra de la voluntad de la madre del último.

programme.title: Operativo de alto riesgo
programme.desc: Una médica forense descubre quienes son sus verdaderos amigos, durante la investigación de un caso de alto riesgo.

programme.title: Desvestidas y alborotadas
programme.desc: Una bella mujer es abandonada por su marido en su luna de miel, y los hombres en el hotel andan detrás de ella.

programme.title: Transplante a la mexicana
programme.desc: Un mujeriego va a prisión por enamorar a una menor de edad, al tiempo una doctora quiere experimentar con sus órganos.

programme.title: Romance en Puerto Rico
programme.desc: Una joven escapa como polizón en un barco que viaja a Puerto Rico para no casarse con un millonario.

programme.title: Santa Claus
programme.desc: Santa y el mago Merlín se unen para frustrar los planes del diablo de extender la tentación entre los niños del mundo.

programme.title: Hoy He Soñado con Dios
programme.desc: Una mujer tiene tres hijos muy diferentes: una hija fracasada, el otro un boxeador furtivo y su hijo el sacerdote.

programme.title: El fin de un imperio
programme.desc: El teniente del batallón de Rurales, José Antonio Navarrete, es considerado héroe y enemigo de los imperialistas, quienes raptan a su gran amor para atraerlo e imponerle sus condiciones políticas.

programme.title: Reencuentros
programme.desc: Al morir su hermano de leucemia, un niño pobre toma su bicicleta y emprende un viaje a la ciudad en busca de su padre.

programme.title: Bello amanecer
programme.desc: La espectacular belleza de una isleña que despierta entre los pescadores las más ardientes y locas pasiones.

programme.title: Las Pobres Ilegales
programme.desc: Una joven huye de su casa por su padrastro y se va a los EE.UU., donde descubre el abuso a los indocumentados.

programme.title: Esposa te doy
programme.desc: Sofía y Alberto, son una pareja de recién casados que descubren que además de amor también hay diferencias en el matrimonio, sin embargo, comienzan a vivir con ellas pretendiendo no darles importancia, pero la tensión comienza a subir de tono.

programme.title: La sombra del Caudillo
programme.desc: El Caudillo no se detiene ante nada en su búsqueda por el poder, valiéndose de la corrupción, la amenaza y el asesinato.

programme.title: El gran Makakikus
programme.desc: Un marqués arruinado pide la mano de una joven para aprovecharse de su familia, pero ella está enamorada de un charro.

programme.title: El Tejedor de Milagros
programme.desc: En Navidad, un indio llega a un pueblo con su esposa embarazada; pero como nadie los ayuda ella da a luz en plena calle.

programme.title: La mesera del café del puerto
programme.desc: Una mesera coja ayuda a un compositor que está en la ruina, logrando superarse y triunfar, luego ella se somete a una cirugía y deciden casarse.

programme.title: El Hombre Inquieto
programme.desc: Un vendedor de periódicos se hace pasar por el medio hermano de una joven, pero termina enamorándose de ella.

programme.title: Operación Tiburón
programme.desc: Un agente del gobierno es contratado para atrapar a un espía y su banda.

programme.title: El hombre que me gusta
programme.desc: Un matrimonio vive de parranda en parranda y acaban con su fortuna, como no consiguen un préstamo él piensa suicidarse.

programme.title: Sangre en el ruedo
programme.desc: Tras la muerte de su padre, un joven estudiante de Magisterio decide hacerse torero, y pronto triunfa como matador.

programme.title: Los Nietos de Don Venancio
programme.desc: Un hombre vuelve a España para un festejo familiar y se entera de que ha ocurrido un incendio en su tienda.

programme.title: Semáforo en Rojo
programme.desc: Un grupo de ladrones profesionales organizan el robo de una valiosa joya.

programme.title: La familia y uno más
programme.desc: Un padre de familia con 16 hijos hace frente a los conflictos, alegrías y los infortunios de una gran familia.

programme.title: Contra viento y marea
programme.desc: Dos hermanos regresan de estudiar química en Europa, desprecian a su enriquecido padre y no lo ayudan en su empresa.

programme.title: La Morena de mi Copla
programme.desc: Un pintor ayuda a una joven gitana y la lleva a vivir a su casa, pero un amigo torero de este se enamora de ella.

programme.title: El rebozo de Soledad
programme.desc: Una humilde pueblerina mancillada muere durante el nacimiento de su bebé y luego su esposo es asesinado.

programme.title: Bartolo toca la flauta
programme.desc: Un joven distraído es apresado con falsos cargos porque al cacique de la región le gusta su novia.

programme.title: Se la llevó el Remington
programme.desc: En la feria del pueblo, una adivina predice a una bella joven que el matón contratado por el cacique la seducirá.

programme.title: Yo fui una usurpadora
programme.desc: La amante de un médico le va a dar el hijo anhelado, él se divorcia de su esposa, pero ella le oculta su reciente embarazo.

programme.title: Archaeology: An Introduction to the World's Greatest Sites
programme.desc: A first look at the wonders of Egyptology; the deciphering of hieroglyphics; the techniques of ancient Egyptian embalming and mummification; the stories behind the building of the Step Pyramid of Zozer, the Pyramids at Giza and the Sphinx.

programme.title: The Greek World: A Study of History and Culture
programme.sub-title: Alexander the Great: Greek Culture Spreads
programme.desc: The conquests of Alexander the Great give birth to the Hellenistic world; Alexander's military expansionism brings a vast geographical area under the Greek civilization; Alexander's empire fragments after his death; Alexandria, a center of learning.

programme.title: The Greek World: A Study of History and Culture
programme.desc: The conflicted relationship between the Greeks and their Roman conquerors; Greek culture's impact on Rome; the founding of the Byzantine Empire, its flourishing of scholarship and theology; the role of Islamic scholars in preserving Greek learning.

programme.title: The Greek World: A Study of History and Culture
programme.desc: Constantinople's fall in 1453; the Greeks under the Ottomans; Europe rediscovers classical antiquity; the philosophical spirit of the Renaissance, which brings a sudden interest in the ancient Greeks; the influence of Greek mythology on Western art.

programme.title: The Greek World: A Study of History and Culture
programme.sub-title: The Birth of the Greek Nation-State
programme.desc: The struggle of the Greeks under the Ottomans; European intellectuals and Europe's major powers support the movement to free Greece; the nation-state of Greece in 1830; Greece's territorial expansion; its tumultuous modern history up to the present.

programme.title: The Fall of the Pagans and the Origins of Medieval Christianity
programme.desc: The influence of philosophy on the morality and conduct of Rome's ruling classes; an influence rarely matched in the Western tradition; Christian theologians employing the doctrines of these two philosophical schools in defining their own faith.

programme.title: The Fall of the Pagans and the Origins of Medieval Christianity
programme.desc: Knowing what role Judaism plays in the Roman Empire; learning how Rome's experience with this stalwart monotheistic faith, the first it has encountered, differs from the challenge of the Christian faith that emerges from it.

programme.title: The Fall of the Pagans and the Origins of Medieval Christianity
programme.desc: The first years of efforts to convert people to Christianity; the early leadership by James of those who are often called Jewish Christians; the career of Paul, from his own conversion after a vision to his work propagating the message of Jesus.

programme.title: The Fall of the Pagans and the Origins of Medieval Christianity
programme.desc: Early responses to Christianity; the violent persecutions in Rome under Nero; the legalistic and easily avoided persecutions under later emperors; Roman ignorance of Christianity; the eventual momentum that ignorance gives the new faith.

programme.title: Great Ancient Civilizations of Asia Minor
programme.desc: As the Hittites unite Anatolia, early Greeks called Achaeans visit its western reaches; Achaean warlords trade and raid along the shores of Asia Minor; in time, they become the first Greeks to clash with the armies of a great king to the east.

programme.title: Great Ancient Civilizations of Asia Minor
programme.desc: The most enduring legacies from early Anatolia are "The Iliad" and "The Odyssey": how the siege of Troy and the exploits of Homer's warrior chieftains fit into the wider tale of imperial struggle and decline during the Greek Dark Age.

programme.title: Great Ancient Civilizations of Asia Minor
programme.sub-title: Iron Age Kingdoms of Asia Minor
programme.desc: From 1200 B.C. to 1000 B.C., migrations reshape Anatolia; Phrygians come from the Balkans, only to be overcome by Cimmerian nomads; in the West, Hittite provincials found trade-rich Lydia, whose last king is Croesus.

programme.title: Great Ancient Civilizations of Asia Minor
programme.desc: From 750 B.C., the Greeks distinguish themselves with the polis, a city-state based on citizen rule; by 500 B.C., Athens devises the first democratic constitution, with all adult male citizens forming the sovereign assembly.

programme.title: The Architecture of Power: Great Palaces of the Ancient World
programme.desc: Exploring the palaces of Saddam Hussein; discovering how he calls upon the ancient Egyptians and Babylonians for inspiration; how the architecture changes over time in response to threats from Iran and the United States.

programme.title: The Architecture of Power: Great Palaces of the Ancient World
programme.sub-title: Malkata Palace: Pharaoh, Foreigners, and Gods
programme.desc: Traveling back to the 14th century B.C. in Egypt; how the Malkata Palace represents a microcosm of Egypt; architectural details reveal insights about religious rituals and how pharaohs attempt to assert their domination over others.

programme.title: The Architecture of Power: Great Palaces of the Ancient World
programme.sub-title: Amarna: Palace of the First Sun King
programme.desc: Akhenaten shifts Egypt's capital to Amarna; how his worship of the sun disk defines an era built on temple crops, sacrifices and obedience to the pharaoh; how relocating his seat of power helps Akhenaten wrestle authority away from religious leaders.

programme.title: The Architecture of Power: Great Palaces of the Ancient World
programme.sub-title: Phaistos: Palaces Between Asia and Europe
programme.desc: Studying Bronze Age Crete; the myth of Daedalus and his labyrinth symbolizes Crete's location at the intersection of multiple cultures; discovering the Phaistos Palace, the site of extravagant religious rituals and entertainment spectacles.

programme.title: The Architecture of Power: Great Palaces of the Ancient World
programme.sub-title: Palace of Nestor at Pylos and Bronze Age Greece
programme.desc: Exploring the Palace of Nestor, a complex centered around the throne room; the ancient styles the Mycenaeans develop to bring these elaborate structures to life; what the arrangement of rooms reveals about how royals live and maintain control.

programme.title: Experiencing Rome: A Visual Exploration of Antiquity's Greatest Empire
programme.desc: Examining the visual nature of Roman society and the key role of spectacular display; ranging from its center in the Roman Forum to its frontiers.

programme.title: Experiencing Rome: A Visual Exploration of Antiquity's Greatest Empire
programme.sub-title: A Brief Survey of the Roman Empire
programme.desc: This lecture provides a chronological, thematic and geographical framework; understanding the visual components of the Roman Empire; especially how different forms of governments and their citizens affect their art, architecture and public display.

programme.title: Experiencing Rome: A Visual Exploration of Antiquity's Greatest Empire
programme.desc: Learning the fundamental role of Rome's military in expanding the empire through conquest; creating and projecting the image of Roman power; introducing non-Romans to Roman values and identity.

programme.title: Experiencing Rome: A Visual Exploration of Antiquity's Greatest Empire
programme.desc: Conquest provides a reason for triumphal processions, sacrifices, games and other grand spectacles; it also allows for public and religious participation in a reinforcement of Roman values and identity.

programme.title: Experiencing Rome: A Visual Exploration of Antiquity's Greatest Empire
programme.desc: Touring the palaces of Rome's powerful rulers; seeing how power and culture are displayed in forms that are admired and imitated by lower social classes.

programme.title: Experiencing Rome: A Visual Exploration of Antiquity's Greatest Empire
programme.desc: As a stage for political, religious and social display, the houses of Roman elites celebrate Roman virtues and cultural identity; reinforcing to social equals and inferiors the influence of the inhabitants.

programme.title: Great Battles of the Ancient World
programme.sub-title: Why Study Battles? What Is War?
programme.desc: Garrett G. Fagan addresses the importance of studying battles and surveys the changing scholarly approach to the subject; he concludes by looking at different definitions of warfare, particularly the operational and social-constructivist models.

programme.title: Great Battles of the Ancient World
programme.desc: Three types of evidence shed light on the origins of warfare; human remains bearing evidence of trauma; artifacts that function primarily as weapons; fortifications or depictions of warriors painted on cave walls; their interpretations are tricky.

programme.title: Great Battles of the Ancient World
programme.sub-title: Sumer, Akkad, and Early Mesopotamian Warfare
programme.desc: Written records first become available in the historical era; evidence reconstructs the conventions and conditions of warfare among the first cities in Sumer circa the 30th century B.C.; exploring the nature of Sumerian armies and battle tactics.

programme.title: Great Battles of the Ancient World
programme.sub-title: Egyptian Warfare From the Old to New Kingdoms
programme.desc: Evidence of warfare in Ancient Egypt is ambiguous, but it is much more plentiful in later periods; the pharaoh's role is increasingly that of a war leader; Egyptian warfare is transformed by the introduction of the chariot.

programme.title: Great Battles of the Ancient World
programme.sub-title: The Battles of Megiddo and Kadesh
programme.desc: In the New Kingdom of Egypt, one gets the first fully recorded battle in history, the Battle of Megiddo; covering the later Battle of Kadesh, which is attested in both Egyptian and Hittite accounts.
